actions.action: Isolate the plant from other plants
Dab visible mealybug with alcohol-soaked cotton swab
Thoroughly inspect leaves, nodes, tips and soil surface for more bugs and egg sacs
Test insecticidal soap or neem oil on a few leaves first
Spray whole plant with insecticidal soap or diluted neem oil every 5-7 days for 3-4 weeks
Check nearby plants for mealybugs and keep checking weekly
If infestation grows, apply systemic imidacloprid insecticide

reason: The answer correctly identifies the mealybug and leads with the same alcohol dab and thorough inspection that worked, with no harmful advice.
